invariants: No additional classifier, reviewer or quality-retry model turn on the default path.
Answer-only requests require neither a repository nor file changes.
Only observed evidence may substantiate completion.
Timing logs never contain prompt, answer or credential content.
Coalesce only already-queued plain text/log events of one execution within bounded groups; retain original journal events and all semantic boundaries.
Explicit matching-claim cancellation before the first terminal attempt supersedes queued provider completion; internal finish cancellation alone does not.
Cancelled executions do not indefinitely retry obsolete running/waiting notifications ahead of their terminal outcome.
An attempted terminal outcome stays immutable across ambiguous delivery failure, late cancellation and shutdown; stable event keys are preserved.

loop.observation: Simple requests could stall on intent gates; failed first-event transitions could lose answer text; empty provider success could be presented as completion. A buffered provider event could miss claim cancellation and wait behind repeated idle long polls. An uncommitted Running notification retained across a user stop could prevent Cancelled delivery forever; an already queued provider completion could ignore an earlier explicit claim cancellation.
loop.hypothesis: Single-turn guidance, buffered delivery and deterministic completion checks improve reliability without a new model call. Claim-fenced cancellation precedence before the first terminal attempt and selective supersession of obsolete intermediate delivery close these two cancellation deadlocks without changing an outcome after ambiguous acknowledgement.
loop.execute: Run scoped offline regressions, full Go tests, race, lint, vet and document/architecture gates. Preserve earlier opt-in live measurements as historical evidence; do not repeat provider calls for this cancellation fix.
loop.evaluate: No extra turn/start on an answer-only task; recover failed delivery text; reject empty unverified results; report timing without a speedup claim from small samples. Pending delivery must not spend the idle poll timeout; idle waves still long poll. Cancellation before queued completion settles once with no retained ownership; superseded lifecycle/approval notifications cannot block it; no-cancel retries and already-attempted terminal keys remain unchanged.
loop.retrospective: Keep semantic quality distinct from deterministic evidence; retain existing opt-in continuations and recovery.

measurement.interpretation: Small unrandomized sample; observed medians increased; no speedup/no-regression claim. SSE receipt, not UI paint.
